title.zh: 卷十八 本紀第十八 哲宗二
title.raw: 卷十八 本紀第十八 哲宗二 Volume 18 Annals 18: Zhezong 2

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年春正月癸酉朔，群臣詣西上閣門進名奉慰。

translations.literal: First year of Shaosheng, spring, first month, day guiyou new moon: officials went to the Western Upper Gate to present their names and offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 1, spring, guiyou new moon: the court filed to the Western Upper Gate with names and words of comfort.

sentences.zh: 丙申，夏人來貢。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Western Xia sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Xia brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣中書舍人呂希純等行河。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Palace Drafting Academician Lyu Xichun and others were sent to inspect the rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Lyu Xichun and a party were dispatched to survey the rivers.

sentences.zh: 罷河東大銅錢。

translations.literal: Large copper coins in Hedong were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong’s large copper coin issue was ended.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，以戶部尚書李清臣爲中書侍郎，兵部尚書鄧潤甫爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingwei: Minister of Revenue Li Qingchen was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; Minister of War Deng Runfu was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dingwei: Li Qingchen took the Chancellery and Deng Runfu the right vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬宣仁聖烈皇后于永厚陵。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Empress Xuanren the Holy and Fierce was buried at Yonghou Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Empress Xuanren was laid in Yonghou Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己未，祔神主於太廟。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: her spirit tablet was enshrined in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, her tablet entered the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，減兩京、河陽、鄭州囚罪一等，民緣山陵役者蠲其賦。

translations.literal: Day guihai: crimes in the Two Capitals, Heyang, and Zhengzhou were reduced one grade; taxes were remitted for people laboring on the mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Two Capitals, Heyang, and Zhengzhou won one-grade sentence relief; mausoleum corvée was tax-free.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔依章獻明肅皇后故事，罷避高遵惠諱。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict followed the precedent of Empress Zhangxian the Bright and Solemn and abolished taboo avoidance for Gao Zunhui’s name.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, following Empress Zhangxian’s precedent, the court stopped avoiding Gao Zunhui’s name.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen new moon: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renshen new moon: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，呂大防罷。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Lü Daguan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Lü Daguan left office.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔大學合格上舍生推恩免省試，附科場春榜。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: an edict granted qualified upper-house students of the Imperial University favor by exempting the provincial examination and attaching them to the spring examination roster.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, qualified upper-house students skipped the provincial exam and went straight onto the spring roster.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，御集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the emperor held the civil examination at the Hall for Gathering Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the throne examined civil graduates at Jiying Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，策武舉。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the military examination was held.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the military examination was held.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以徐王顥爲太師，徙封冀王。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Prince Xu was made Grand Preceptor and transferred to Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Prince Xu became Grand Preceptor and was moved to the Ji princedom.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔振京東、河北流民，貸以谷麥種，諭使還業，蠲是年租稅。

translations.literal: Day guisi: an edict ordered relief for migrants in Jingdong and Hebei, loans of grain and seed, exhortation to return to their fields, and remission of that year’s taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Jingdong and Hebei migrants were fed, lent seed, urged home, and freed from that year’s tax.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身九百七十五人。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: nine hundred seventy-five men who had passed the Ministry of Rites roster examination and various special examinations were granted jinshi and other degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, nine hundred seventy-five men received jinshi and other degrees from the Ministry of Rites list.

sentences.zh: 蘇轍罷。

translations.literal: Su Zhe was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Su Zhe left office.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳朔，阿里骨進獅子。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi new moon: Aligu presented a lion.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yisi new moon: Aligu sent a lion.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以旱，詔恤刑。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: because of drought, an edict ordered compassionate handling of criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, drought brought an edict for lenient justice.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔中外決獄。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: an edict ordered trials decided inside and outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, cases inside and outside the capital were to be decided at once.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔有司具醫藥治京師民疾。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: an edict ordered the relevant offices to supply medicine to treat sickness among the capital populace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the capital sick were to receive state medicine.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蘇軾坐前掌制命語涉譏訕，落職知英州。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Su Shi, for language in earlier drafting edicts that involved ridicule, was stripped of office and made prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Su Shi lost his post for mockery in old proclamations and was sent to Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，改元。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the reign title changed.

sentences.zh: 白虹貫日。

translations.literal: A white rainbow crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A white rainbow cut the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以王安石配饗神宗廟庭。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Wang Anshi was granted shared sacrifice in Emperor Shenzong’s temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Wang Anshi was enshrined beside Shenzong in the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 蔡確追復右正議大夫。

translations.literal: Cai Que was posthumously restored to Right Corrective Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Que was posthumously restored as Right Corrective Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 戊午，復新城兩廂。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the inner and outer wards of the new city were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the new city’s twin wards were reopened.

sentences.zh: 庚申，減四京囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: crimes in the four capitals were reduced one grade; those punished by beating or below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the four capitals won one-grade remission; beatings and lighter sentences were cleared.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以資政殿學士章惇爲尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance Zhang Dun was made Left Grand Councillor and concurrent Vice Director of the Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Zhang Dun became Left Grand Councillor and Gate Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 範純仁罷。

translations.literal: Fan Zuren was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zuren left office.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷五路經、律、通禮科。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the examinations in the classics, statutory law, and comprehensive rites on the five circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the five-circuit classic, law, and comprehensive-rites examinations were scrapped.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔諸路復元豐免役法。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict ordered all circuits to restore the Yuanfeng exemption-service law.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, every circuit was told to restore Yuanfeng exemption-service rules.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，同修國史蔡卞請重修《神宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: joint compiler of the National History Cai Bian requested a new compilation of the Shenzong Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Cai Bian asked to rewrite the Shenzong Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬申，復提舉常平官。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day renshen: the Ever-Normal Granary commissioners were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary renshen: Ever-Normal Granary commissioners returned.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷十科舉士法。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the Ten-Category Examination for office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the ten-category civil examination ended.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以觀文殿學士安燾爲門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture An Yan was made Vice Director of the Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, An Yan became Gate Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，復義倉。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Charity Granaries were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the Charity Granaries were restored.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔神宗隨龍人趙世長等遷秩、賜齎有差。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict ordered Shenzong’s dragon-following followers Zhao Shichang and others advanced in rank and given stipends in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Shenzong’s old companions Zhao Shichang and the rest were promoted and paid varying stipends.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔在京諸司，所受傳宣中批，並候朝廷覆奏以行。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: an edict ordered all capital offices that received medium imperial orders and inner drafts to await court review and confirmation before acting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, capital offices had to wait for court confirmation before carrying out medium orders or inner drafts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，西南張蕃遣人入貢。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the Southwestern Zhang Fan sent people to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the southwestern Zhang Fan brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命左僕射章惇提舉修《神宗國史》。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Left Grand Councillor Zhang Dun was ordered to direct the compilation of the Shenzong National History.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Zhang Dun was put in charge of the Shenzong National History.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔添差徐州兵馬都監。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict added the post of Xuzhou military supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, a Xuzhou military supervisor was added.

sentences.zh: 五月壬寅，罷修官制局。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renyin: the Bureau for Revising the Official System was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renyin: the office-reform bureau was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷進士習試詩賦，令專二經，立宏詞科。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the jinshi trial composition in regulated poetry was abolished; candidates were to focus on two classics, and the Hongci examination was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, jinshi poetry trials ended, the exam fixed on two classics, and the Hongci degree was created.

sentences.zh: 己酉，修國史曾布請以王安石《日錄》載之《神宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: compiler of the National History Zeng Bu requested that Wang Anshi’s Diary be entered into the Shenzong Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Zeng Bu asked to lodge Wang Anshi’s Diary in the Shenzong Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，劉奉世罷。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Liu Fengshi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Liu Fengshi left office.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔中外學官，非制科、進士、上舍生入官者並罷。

translations.literal: Day guichou: an edict dismissed all academic officials who had entered office by routes other than the special examination, jinshi examination, or upper-house students.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, every academic official not from the special exam, jinshi, or upper house was removed.

sentences.zh: 編類元祐群臣章疏及更改事條。

translations.literal: Yuanyou ministers’ memorials and lists of changed policies were compiled and classified.
translations.idiomatic: The court compiled Yuanyou ministers’ memorials and the roster of policy reversals.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，右正言張商英言先帝謂天地合祭非古，詔禮部、太常詳議以聞。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Right Remonstrance Officer Zhang Shangying said the late emperor had held that the joint sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was not ancient; an edict ordered the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to deliberate in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhang Shangying cited Shenzong’s doubt that Heaven-and-Earth joint sacrifice was unorthodox; Rites and Imperial Sacrifices were to report.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鄧潤甫卒。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Deng Runfu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Deng Runfu died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，嗣濮王宗暉薨。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Heir of Pu Wang Zonghui died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Heir of Pu Wang Zonghui died.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，來之邵等疏蘇軾詆斥先朝，詔謫惠州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiaxu: Lai Zhi Shao and others memorialized that Su Shi had reviled and denounced the prior reign; an edict exiled him to Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiaxu: Lai Zhi Shao’s party impeached Su Shi for slandering the prior reign; he was banished to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙子，罷制置解鹽使。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Commissioner for Managing Liberated Salt was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the liberated-salt commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，封高密郡王宗晟爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Day renwu: Prince Zongcheng of Gaomi was enfeoffed Heir of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Prince Zongcheng of Gaomi was made Heir of Pu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以翰林學士承旨曾布同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: Hanlin Academician and Proclamation Drafter Zeng Bu was made Co-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Zeng Bu joined the Bureau of Military Affairs as co-director.

sentences.zh: 甲申，除進士引用王安石《字說》之禁。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the ban on jinshi candidates citing Wang Anshi’s Explaining Characters was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, jinshi candidates could again cite Wang Anshi’s Explaining Characters.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，以御史黃履、周秩、諫官張商英言，奪司馬光、呂公著贈諡，王岩叟贈官；

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi: on the memorials of surveillance censor Huang Lü, palace censor Zhou Zhi, and remonstrance officer Zhang Shangying, posthumous titles were stripped from Sima Guang and Lü Gongzhu and an office grant from Wang Yansou;
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingsi: at Huang Lü, Zhou Zhi, and Zhang Shangying’s urging, posthumous honors were stripped from Sima Guang, Lü Gongzhu, and Wang Yansou;

sentences.zh: 貶呂大防爲秘書監，劉摯爲光祿卿，蘇轍爲少府監，並分司南京；

translations.literal: Lü Daguan was demoted to Director of the Palace Library, Liu Zhi to Minister of the Palace Storehouse, and Su Zhe to Director of the Court of Imperial Manufactories—all with nominal posts and assigned to reside at Nanjing;
translations.idiomatic: Lü Daguan, Liu Zhi, and Su Zhe were demoted to nominal posts at Nanjing;

sentences.zh: 梁燾提舉舒州靈仙觀。

translations.literal: Liang Xi was made supervisor of Lingxian Abbey in Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Xi was sent to supervise Lingxian Abbey in Shuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔：「大臣朋黨，司馬光以下各輕重議罰，佈告天下。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: “Ministers formed factions; from Sima Guang downward each is to be punished according to the severity of the case, and this is to be proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the throne proclaimed: “The ministers formed factions; from Sima Guang down each will be punished in proportion, and the realm will hear it.

sentences.zh: 餘悉不問，議者亦勿復言。

translations.literal: The remainder are not to be pursued further, and remonstrators are not to raise the matter again.”
translations.idiomatic: The rest are spared further inquiry, and remonstrance on it must cease.”

sentences.zh: 」八月丙戌，召輔臣觀稼後苑。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: chief ministers were summoned to view the harvest in the rear garden.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingxu: the chief ministers were called to inspect the harvest in the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 日有五色雲。

translations.literal: The sun showed five-colored clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Five-colored clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，應制科趙天啟以累上書狂妄黜。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Zhao Tianqi of the special examination for drafting was expelled for repeatedly submitting reckless memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, drafting examinee Zhao Tianqi was expelled for reckless repeated memorials.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，遣御史劉拯按河北水災，振饑民。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: Surveillance Censor Liu Zheng was sent to investigate the Hebei flood disaster and relieve the famine populace.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guimao: Liu Zheng was sent to probe Hebei’s flood and feed the hungry.

sentences.zh: 丙午，御集英殿，策賢良方正能直言極諫科。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the emperor held the examination for worthies of excellent conduct who can speak frankly and remonstrate to the utmost at the Hall for Gathering Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the throne examined outspoken worthies at Jiying Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷制科。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the special examination system was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the special examination system was abolished.

sentences.zh: 罷廣惠倉。

translations.literal: The Broad Relief Granary was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Broad Relief Granary was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，令監司歲察守臣課績優者以聞。

translations.literal: Day guichou: an edict ordered circuit commissioners each year to investigate prefects’ performance and report those who were outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, circuit commissioners were to report prefects of outstanding yearly performance.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，知廣州唐義問坐棄渠陽砦，責授舒州團練副使。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Guangzhou prefect Tang Yiwen, for abandoning the Quyang stockade, was demoted to training vice commissioner of Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Tang Yiwen of Guangzhou was demoted for abandoning Quyang stockade.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Venus shone by day again.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔京東西、河北振恤流民。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict ordered relief for migrants in eastern and western Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, eastern and western Hebei migrants were ordered relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，流星出紫微垣。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: a meteor issued from the Purple Subtlety enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, a meteor shot from the Purple Subtlety enclosure.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，三佛齊遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: Sanfoqi sent envoys to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingchen: Sanfoqi sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，河北流斷絕。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Hebei migrant routes were cut off.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Hebei migrant routes were severed.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥朔，復八路差官法。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai new moon: the eight-route differential appointment law was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jihai new moon: the eight-route appointment law returned.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以冬無雪，決系囚。

translations.literal: Day renzi: because there was no winter snow, prisoners in confinement were released.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, a snowless winter brought release for prisoners in confinement.

sentences.zh: 蔡確特追復觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: Cai Que was specially posthumously restored to Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Que was specially posthumously restored as Observing Culture academician.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，開封男子呂安斥乘輿，當斬，貸之。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: a Kaifeng man, Lü An, reviled the imperial carriage; the penalty was death, but he was spared.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Lü An of Kaifeng insulted the imperial carriage; though liable to death, he was spared.

sentences.zh: 丁己，詔河北振饑，諸路恤流亡，官吏有善狀、才能顯著者以聞。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: an edict ordered Hebei famine relief, all circuits to care for displaced people, and officials of good conduct and marked ability to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Hebei was ordered fed, every circuit to shelter exiles, and able officials reported up.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，申嚴銅錢出外界法。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: the law forbidding copper cash to leave the border was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinwei: the ban on copper cash leaving the realm was tightened.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命諸路祈雪。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: all circuits were ordered to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, every circuit was told to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，滑州浮橋火。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: the Huazhou pontoon bridge caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Huazhou’s pontoon bridge burned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，漳河決溢，浸洺、磁等州，令計置堙塞。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the Zhang River breached and overflowed, inundating Ming and Ci prefectures; an order was issued to plan blocking and filling.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the Zhang River broke and drowned Ming and Ci; the court ordered the breach dammed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，范祖禹、趙彥若、黃庭堅坐史事責授散官，永、澧、黔州安置。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Fan Zuyu, Zhao Yanruo, and Huang Tingjian, for offenses in the history office, were demoted to nominal office and assigned to residence at Yong, Li, and Qian prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Fan Zuyu, Zhao Yanruo, and Huang Tingjian were stripped for the history-office affair and sent to Yong, Li, and Qian.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師疫，洛水溢，太原地震，河北水，發京東粟振之。

translations.literal: That year there was plague in the capital; the Luo River overflowed; Taiyuan had an earthquake; Hebei flooded; grain from Jingdong was dispatched for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital sicked, the Luo flooded, Taiyuan shook, Hebei drowned, and Jingdong grain went north for relief.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲辰，詔國史院增補先帝御集。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day jiachen: an edict ordered the National History Institute to supplement the late emperor’s collected writings.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 2, spring, jiachen: the National History Institute was told to supplement Shenzong’s collected writings.

sentences.zh: 丙午，立宏詞科。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the Hongci examination was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Hongci examination was established.

sentences.zh: 己未，遷奉太平興國寺三朝御容于天章閣。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the three-reign imperial portraits of Taiping Xingguo Temple were moved to Tianzhang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Taiping Xingguo’s three-reign imperial portraits were moved to Tianzhang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，殿前司奏獄空，詔賜緡錢。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Palace Command reported empty prisons; an edict granted cash rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Palace Command reported empty jails and received a cash reward.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，呂大防以監修史事貶秩，分司南京、安州居住。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai: Lü Daguan, for supervising the history compilation, was demoted in rank and assigned to reside at Nanjing and Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yihai: Lü Daguan was further demoted for overseeing the histories and sent to Nanjing and Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，出內庫錢帛二十萬助河北振饑。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: two hundred thousand in cash and silks from the inner treasury was issued to assist Hebei famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, two hundred thousand in treasury cash and silk went to Hebei relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷廣文館解額。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Guangwenguan examination quota was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Guangwenguan quota was abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，宗晟薨。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: Zongcheng died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jihai: Zongcheng died.

sentences.zh: 己未，試宏詞黃符等五人各循一資。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: in the Hongci examination Huang Fu and five others each advanced one grade in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Hongci graduates Huang Fu and five others each rose one grade.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，詔職事官罷帶職，朝請大夫以下勿分左右，易集賢院學士爲集賢殿修撰，直集賢院爲直秘閣，集賢校理爲秘閣校理。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuchen: an edict ordered functional officials to drop concurrent titles; Court Gentlemen and below were no longer divided into left and right; Academician of the Hall for Assembling Worthies was changed to Compiler of the Hall for Assembling Worthies; Direct Academician of the Hall for Assembling Worthies was changed to Direct Academician of the Secret Pavilion; Proofreader of the Hall for Assembling Worthies was changed to Proofreader of the Secret Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, wuchen: functional officials shed concurrent titles; court gentlemen were unified; Hanlin and academy titles were renamed to the Secret Pavilion system.

sentences.zh: 壬申，封華容郡王宗愈爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Day renshen: Prince Zongyu of Huarong was enfeoffed Heir of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Prince Zongyu of Huarong was made Heir of Pu.

sentences.zh: 詔許將等七人，不限資格，各舉才行堪備任使者二人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xu Jiang and six others, without limit on qualifications, each to recommend two men whose talent and conduct were fit to be entrusted with missions.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jiang and six others were told—rank no bar—to name two men each fit for special appointment.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔依元豐條置律學博士二員。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: an edict ordered two law-school doctorate posts established according to Yuanfeng regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, two law-school doctorates were restored under the Yuanfeng rules.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，命蔡卞詳定國子監三學及外州州學制。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi: Cai Bian was ordered to detail regulations for the Directorate of Education’s three schools and prefectural schools in outer circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi: Cai Bian was assigned to draft statutes for the imperial three schools and circuit prefectural schools.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，六月壬辰，禁京城士人輿轎。

translations.literal: Day yimao, sixth month, day renchen: capital scholars were forbidden sedan chairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, and again sixth month renchen, capital scholars were barred from sedan chairs.

sentences.zh: 上皇太妃宮名曰聖瑞。

translations.literal: The Retired Emperor’s consort dowager’s palace was named Holy Auspice.
translations.idiomatic: The retired emperor’s consort dowager’s residence was named Holy Auspice.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔大理寺復置右治獄，仍依元豐例添置官屬。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen: an edict restored the right prison at the Court of Judicial Review and, following the Yuanfeng precedent, added officials.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingchen: the Court of Judicial Review’s right prison was restored with Yuanfeng staffing.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，命彰信軍節度使宗景爲開府儀同三司，封濟陰郡王。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renshen: Military Commissioner of Zhangxin Army Zong Jing was made Honorary Grand Councilor of State and enfeoffed Prince of Jiyin commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renshen: Zong Jing of Zhangxin Army became honorary grand councilor and Prince of Jiyin.

sentences.zh: 甲申，宗愈薨。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Zong Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zong Yu died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，錄趙普後希莊爲閣門祗候。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Zhao Pu’s descendant Xizhuang was enrolled as a palace gate usher.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Zhao Pu’s descendant Xizhuang was posted as a palace gate usher.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，以安定郡王宗綽爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: Prince Zongchuo of Anding commandery was made Heir of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiawu: Prince Zongchuo of Anding was made Heir of Pu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，告遷神宗神御于景靈宮顯承殿。

translations.literal: Day renyin: notice was given of moving Shenzong’s imperial spirit portrait to Xuancheng Hall in Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the court announced Shenzong’s spirit portrait would move to Xuancheng Hall in Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詣景靈宮，行奉安禮。

translations.literal: Day guimao: he went to Jingling Palace and performed the enshrinement rite.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, he went to Jingling Palace for the enshrinement rite.

sentences.zh: 戊申，加上神宗諡曰紹天法古運德建功英文烈武欽仁聖孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Shenzong’s posthumous title was augmented: “Emperor who Continues Heaven, Follows Antiquity, Conveys Virtue, Achieves Meritorious Accomplishment, Cultivates Literary Culture, Displays Martial Fierceness, esteems Benevolence, manifests Sagacity and Filial Piety.”
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Shenzong received the augmented posthumous title “Continues Heaven, Follows Antiquity, Conveys Virtue, Achieves Merit, Cultivates Culture, Displays Martial Fierceness, esteems Benevolence, manifests Sagacity and Filial Piety.”

sentences.zh: 己酉，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: audience offering at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, offerings were made at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: audience feast at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the court feasted at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大饗明堂，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Bright Hall was grandly sacrificed to; the realm was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Bright Hall rites were held and the realm was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，鄭雍罷。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiazi: Zheng Yong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiazi: Zheng Yong left office.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，告遷宣仁聖烈皇后神御于景靈宮徽音殿。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: notice was given of moving Empress Xuanren the Holy and Fierce’s imperial spirit portrait to Huiyin Hall in Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the court announced Empress Xuanren’s spirit portrait would move to Huiyin Hall in Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詣宮行奉安禮。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: he went to the palace and performed the enshrinement rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, he went to the palace for the enshrinement rite.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書許將爲尚書左丞，翰林學士蔡卞爲尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Xu Jiang was made Left Vice Director of the Ministries; Hanlin Academician Cai Bian was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jiang became left vice premier; Cai Bian became right vice premier.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，進封冀王顥爲楚王。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Prince Hao of Ji was advanced to Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Prince Hao of Ji was raised to Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯。

translations.literal: Day xinmao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao.

sentences.zh: 河南府地震。

translations.literal: Henan prefecture had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Henan prefecture shook.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，安燾罷知河南府。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yiwei: An Yan was dismissed as prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, yiwei: An Yan left the Henan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，範鍔自轉運使入對，言有捕盜功，乞賜章服。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Fan E, coming from transport commissioner to audience, said he had merit in capturing bandits and begged conferral of insignia robes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, transport commissioner Fan E, at audience, claimed bandit-catching merit and asked for insignia robes.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「捕盜，常職也，何足言功？

translations.literal: The emperor said: “Capturing bandits is ordinary duty—how is it enough to speak of merit?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: “Catching bandits is routine work—what merit is there to claim?

sentences.zh: 」黜知壽州。

translations.literal: ” He was demoted to prefect of Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: ” He was sent down to Shouzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，梁惟簡除名、全州安置。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Liang Weijian was stripped of his name and assigned to reside at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liang Weijian was struck from the rolls and exiled to Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，贈蔡確爲太師，賜諡忠懷。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Cai Que was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous name Loyal Remembrance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Cai Que was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with the name Loyal Remembrance.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，復置監察御史三人，分領六察，不言事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yichou: three investigating censors were restored, each to head two of the six inspections, without memorializing on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yichou: three investigating censors returned, split over the six inspections, barred from general memorializing.

sentences.zh: 令翰林學士蔡京、御史中丞黃履各舉御史二人。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Cai Jing and Censor-in-Chief Huang Lü were each ordered to recommend two censors.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jing and Censor-in-Chief Huang Lü were each told to name two censors.

sentences.zh: 壬申，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Day renshen: a white rainbow crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, a white rainbow cut the sun.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔如元豐例，孟月朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: an edict ordered that, as in the Yuanfeng precedent, offerings be presented at Jingling Palace in the first month of each season.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, seasonal first-month offerings at Jingling Palace were ordered restored under the Yuanfeng rule.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蘇州夏、秋地震。

translations.literal: That year Suzhou had earthquakes in summer and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: That year Suzhou shook in summer and again in autumn.

sentences.zh: 桂陽監慶雲見。

translations.literal: Auspicious clouds appeared at Guiyang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious clouds were seen at Guiyang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 出宮女九十一人。

translations.literal: Ninety-one palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-one palace women were sent out.

sentences.zh: 交阯、三佛齊、韋蕃、阿里骨入貢。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi, Sanfoqi, the Wei Fan, and Aligu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhi, Sanfoqi, the Wei Fan, and Aligu brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚子，韓忠彥罷知真定府。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day gengzi: Han Zhongyan was dismissed as prefect of Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 3, spring, gengzi: Han Zhongyan left the Zhending prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，朝獻景靈宮，遍詣諸殿，如元豐禮。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: offerings were presented at Jingling Palace, visiting every hall as in the Yuanfeng rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the court offered at Jingling Palace and visited every hall by the Yuanfeng rite.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，引見蕃官包順、包誠等，賜齎有差。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: frontier officials Bao Shun, Bao Cheng, and others were received in audience and given gifts in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, frontier officers Bao Shun, Bao Cheng, and others were received and paid graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 詔鞫獄非本章所指而蔓求他罪者，論如律。

translations.literal: Edict: in trial cases, those who beyond the original charge branch out to seek other crimes are to be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred prosecutors from piling on crimes beyond the original charge.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔戶部尚書勿領右曹。

translations.literal: Day yimao: an edict ordered the Minister of Revenue not to head the right bureau concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the Minister of Revenue was forbidden to hold the right bureau concurrently.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔罷合祭，間因大禮之歲，夏至日躬祭地祇於北郊。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: an edict abolished the joint sacrifice; in years of the grand rites, on the summer solstice the emperor would personally sacrifice to Earth at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, combined Heaven-and-Earth sacrifice ended; in grand-rite years the emperor would worship Earth at the northern suburb on the summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，以禁中屢火，罷春宴及幸池苑，不御垂拱殿三日。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen: because fires had repeatedly broken out in the inner palace, the spring banquet and visits to the pool gardens were cancelled, and the emperor did not hold court at Chuigong Hall for three days.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renchen: repeated inner-palace fires cancelled the spring feast and pool visits; the throne stayed away from Chuigong Hall three days.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，夏人圍塞門砦。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Western Xia besieged Saimen stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Xia besieged Saimen stockade.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，尚書省火。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: fire at the Ministry headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Ministry headquarters burned.

sentences.zh: 戊午，劍南東川地震。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: eastern Sichuan circuit had an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, eastern Sichuan shook.

sentences.zh: 己亥，封宗楚爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Zong Chu was enfeoffed Heir of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zong Chu was made Heir of Pu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封大寧郡王佖爲申王，遂甯郡王佶爲端王。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Prince Bian of Daning commandery was enfeoffed Prince Shen; Prince Ji of Suining commandery was enfeoffed Prince Duan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Prince Bian of Daning became Prince Shen and Prince Ji of Suining became Prince Duan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，幸申王、端王府。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the emperor visited the mansions of Princes Shen and Duan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the emperor visited Princes Shen and Duan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，罷宣徽使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinyou: the commissioner of palace administration was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, xinyou: the palace administration commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔自今景靈宮四孟朝獻，分爲二日。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: an edict ordered that from now the four seasonal offerings at Jingling Palace be divided over two days.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Jingling’s four seasonal offerings were split across two days.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renzi: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renzi: Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，錄囚。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，令真定立趙普廟。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: Zhending was ordered to erect a temple to Zhao Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guihai: Zhending was told to build a temple to Zhao Pu.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立北郊齋宮於瑞聖園。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: the northern-suburb fasting palace was established in Ruisheng Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, a northern-suburb fasting palace was built in Ruisheng Garden.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，依元豐職事官以行、守、試三等定祿秩。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: following Yuanfeng functional officials, acting, holding, and probationary grades were used to fix salary ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, gengxu: Yuanfeng rules tied pay to acting, holding, and probationary grades.

sentences.zh: 罷元祐所增聚義錢。

translations.literal: The mutual-aid funds added in the Yuanyou era were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou-era mutual-aid funds were scrapped.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，令熙河立王韶廟。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Xihe was ordered to erect a temple to Wang Shao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Xihe was told to build a temple to Wang Shao.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，夏人寇寧順砦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinyou: Western Xia raided Ningshun stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinyou: Xia raided Ningshun stockade.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，日上有五色暈，下有五色氣。

translations.literal: Day renxu: above the sun was a five-colored halo; below it five-colored vapors.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, a five-colored halo crowned the sun and five-colored vapors lay beneath it.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復置檢法官。

translations.literal: Day jimao: legal review officials were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, legal review officials returned.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以范祖禹、劉安世在元祐中構造誣謗，祖禹責授昭州別駕、賀州安置，安世新州別駕、英州安置。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: because Fan Zuyu and Liu Anshi in the Yuanyou era had fabricated slander, Fan was demoted to vice-prefect of Zhao prefecture and assigned to Hezhou; Liu was demoted to vice-prefect of Xin prefecture and assigned to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Fan Zuyu and Liu Anshi were punished for Yuanyou slander—Fan to Zhao vice-prefect and Hezhou exile, Liu to Xin vice-prefect and Yingzhou exile.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，章惇上《神宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingwei: Zhang Dun presented the Shenzong Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingwei: Zhang Dun submitted the Shenzong Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宴修實錄官。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the compilers of the veritable records were banqueted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the veritable-records compilers were feasted.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，宗景坐以立妾罔上，罷開府儀同三司、判大宗正司事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinyou: Zong Jing, for taking a concubine and deceiving the throne, was dismissed as Honorary Grand Councilor and director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, xinyou: Zong Jing lost his honors for secretly taking a concubine and was removed from the clan directorship.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，置施州鑄錢廣積監。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the Guangji coin-casting office was established at Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Shizhou gained the Guangji mint.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，蔡京上《新修大學敕令式》、《詳定重修敕令》。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Cai Jing presented the Newly Revised University Statutes and Formulary and the Detailed Revision of Reissued Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Cai Jing submitted the revised university statutes and the detailed reissue of statutes.

sentences.zh: 遺棄饑貧小兒三歲以下，聽收養爲真子孫。

translations.literal: Abandoned starving poor children under three years of age might be adopted as true descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Starving infants under three abandoned by the poor could be adopted as lawful heirs.

sentences.zh: 是歲，於闐、大食、龜茲師王國、西南蕃龍氏、羅氏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Khotan, Dashi, the Kucha Shiwang kingdom, and the Long and Luo clans of the southwestern fan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Khotan, Dashi, Kucha Shiwang, and southwestern Long and Luo chiefs brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 宗室子授官者四十六人。

translations.literal: Forty-six imperial clansmen were granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-six clansmen received posts.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙戌朔，不受朝。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day bingxu new moon: the emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: Shaosheng 4, spring, bingxu new moon: the throne did not receive court.

sentences.zh: 群臣及遼使詣東上閣門拜表賀。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials and Liao envoys went to the Eastern Upper Gate to bow and submit congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and Liao envoys congratulated at the Eastern Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 班內外學制。

translations.literal: Inner and outer school regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Inner and outer school rules were issued.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以阿里骨子瞎征襲河西軍節度使、邈川首領。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: Aligu’s son Xiazheng succeeded as military commissioner of Hexi Army and chief of Miaochuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Aligu’s son Xiazheng took Hexi Army and Miaochuan leadership.

sentences.zh: 甲午，涇原路鈐轄王文振敗夏人於沒煙峽。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Jingyuan circuit military controller Wang Wenzhen defeated Western Xia at Moyan Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wang Wenzhen of Jingyuan beat Xia at Moyan Gorge.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，李清臣罷。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Li Qingchen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Li Qingchen left office.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，以三省言，追貶呂公著爲建武軍節度副使，司馬光爲清遠軍節度副使，王岩叟爲雷州別駕，奪趙瞻、傅堯俞贈諡，追韓維致仕及孫固、范百祿、胡宗愈遺表恩。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: on the Three Departments’ memorial, Lü Gongzhu was retroactively demoted to deputy military commissioner of Jianwu Army, Sima Guang to deputy military commissioner of Qingyuan Army, and Wang Yansou to vice-prefect of Leizhou; posthumous titles were stripped from Zhao Zhan and Fu Yaoyu; the retirement stipend of Han Wei and the memorial-table favors of Sun Gu, Fan Bailu, and Hu Zongyu were reclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiwei: the Three Departments retroactively demoted Lü Gongzhu, Sima Guang, and Wang Yansou, stripped Zhao Zhan and Fu Yaoyu of posthumous honors, and clawed back favors to Han Wei, Sun Gu, Fan Bailu, and Hu Zongyu.

sentences.zh: 詔江、淮巡檢依舊法招置土兵。

translations.literal: Edict: Jiang and Huai river patrol officers were to recruit local troops according to the old law.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol officers on the Jiang and Huai were told to recruit local troops by the old rules.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，于闐來貢，黑汗王攻夏人三州，遣其子以聞。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Khotan sent tribute; the Black Khan king attacked three Xia prefectures and sent his son to report it.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Khotan brought tribute; the Black Khan struck three Xia prefectures and sent his son with word.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，夏人寇綏德城。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Western Xia raided Suide city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xia raided Suide.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔國信使毋得以非例之物遺人使，仍著條禁。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: an edict ordered diplomatic envoys not to gift irregular items to foreign envoys, and statute prohibitions were enacted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, envoys were forbidden irregular gifts to foreign missions, with new statutory bans.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔申王佖、端王佶歲賜錢各六千五百緡。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: an edict granted Princes Shen Bian and Duan Ji six thousand five hundred strings of cash each year.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Princes Shen and Duan were granted sixty-five hundred strings of cash yearly.

sentences.zh: 丙子，進神宗婉儀宋氏爲賢妃。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Shenzong’s Lady of Graceful Deportment Song was advanced to Honored Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Shenzong’s Lady Song was raised to Honored Consort.

sentences.zh: 己卯，復元豐榷茶法。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the Yuanfeng tea monopoly law was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Yuanfeng tea monopoly returned.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷《春秋》科。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: the Spring and Autumn examination category was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Spring and Autumn exam category ended.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以三省言，追貶呂大防爲舒州團練副使，劉摯爲鼎州團練副使，蘇轍爲化州別駕，梁燾爲雷州別駕，範純仁爲武安軍節度副使，安置於循、新、雷、化、永五州；

translations.literal: Day guimao: on the Three Departments’ memorial, Lü Daguan was retroactively demoted to training vice commissioner of Shuzhou, Liu Zhi to Dingzhou, Su Zhe to vice-prefect of Huazhou, Liang Xi to vice-prefect of Leizhou, and Fan Zuren to deputy military commissioner of Wu’an Army, assigned to residence at Xun, Xin, Lei, Hua, and Yong prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Three Departments further demoted Lü Daguan, Liu Zhi, Su Zhe, Liang Xi, and Fan Zuren to exile posts across Xun, Xin, Lei, Hua, and Yong;

sentences.zh: 劉奉世爲光祿少卿、分司南京；

translations.literal: Liu Fengshi was made Vice Minister of the Imperial Banquets with nominal duty at Nanjing;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fengshi was made vice minister of imperial banquets with nominal duty at Nanjing;

sentences.zh: 黜韓維以下三十人輕重有差。

translations.literal: Han Wei and thirty others below him were demoted with differing severity.
translations.idiomatic: Han Wei and thirty more were punished in graded degrees.

sentences.zh: 甲申，降文彥博爲太子少保。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: Wen Yanbo was demoted to Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Wen Yanbo was reduced to junior mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌朔，張天說坐上書詆訕先朝處死。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingxu new moon: Zhang Tianshuo was executed for memorials slandering the prior reign.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary bingxu new moon: Zhang Tianshuo was put to death for defaming the prior reign.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以曾布知樞密院事，許將爲中書侍郎，蔡卞爲尚書左丞，吏部尚書黃履爲尚書右丞，翰林學士林希同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Zeng Bu was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xu Jiang was made Vice Director of the Chancellery; Cai Bian was made Left Vice Director of the Ministries; Minister of Personnel Huang Lü was made Right Vice Director; Hanlin Academician Lin Xi was made Co-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zeng Bu directed Military Affairs; Xu Jiang took the Chancellery; Cai Bian and Huang Lü became left and right vice premiers; Lin Xi joined Military Affairs as co-director.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大雨雹。

translations.literal: Day guimao: heavy hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，蘇軾責授瓊州別駕，移昌化軍安置。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Su Shi was demoted to vice-prefect of Qiongzhou and moved to assignment at Changhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Su Shi was demoted to Qiong vice-prefect and exiled to Changhua Army.

sentences.zh: 范祖禹移賓州安置，劉安世移高州安置，己酉，御集英殿策進士。

translations.literal: Fan Zuyu was moved to assignment at Binzhou; Liu Anshi was moved to assignment at Gaozhou; day jiyou: the emperor held the civil examination at the Hall for Gathering Excellence.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zuyu was sent to Binzhou and Liu Anshi to Gaozhou; on jiyou the throne examined civil graduates at Jiying Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，策武舉。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the military examination was held.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the military examination was held.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，夏人犯麟州神堂堡，出兵討之，及進築胡山砦。

translations.literal: Third month, day renxu: Western Xia attacked Shen Castle at Lin prefecture; troops were sent to attack them, and they also advanced to build Hushan stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renxu: Xia struck Lin’s Shen Castle; Song forces counterattacked and pushed construction of Hushan stockade.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身六百九人。

translations.literal: Day guihai: six hundred nine men who had passed the Ministry of Rites roster examination and various special examinations were granted jinshi and other degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, six hundred nine men received jinshi and other degrees from the Ministry of Rites list.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔武舉謝師古等以遠人賜帛，李惟岳以高年賜帛。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: an edict granted silk to military graduates Xie Shigu and others as men from distant places, and to Li Weiyue for advanced age.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, military graduates Xie Shigu and others from afar, and the aged Li Weiyue, were granted silk.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔瀘南安撫司、南平軍毋擅誘楊光榮獻納播州疆土。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: an edict ordered the Luzhou pacification commission and Nanping Army not on their own to entice Yang Guangrong to present Bozhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Luzhou and Nanping were forbidden to lure Yang Guangrong into ceding Bozhou land.

sentences.zh: 庚午，夏人大至葭盧城下，知石州張構等擊走之。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Xia forces came in great numbers below Jialu city; Zhang Gou, prefect of Shizhou, and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, a large Xia force reached Jialu; Zhang Gou of Shizhou and others beat them back.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸金明池。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the emperor visited Jinming Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the emperor visited Jinming Pool.

sentences.zh: 丙子，剋胡山新砦成，賜名平羌砦。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the new stockade on captured Husan was completed and named Pingqiang Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the new Husan stockade was finished and named Pingqiang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，西上閣門使折克行破夏人于長波川，斬首二千餘級，獲牛馬倍之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: Western Upper Gate commissioner Zhe Kexing defeated the Xia at Changbo River, beheaded more than two thousand, and captured twice as many cattle and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Zhe Kexing routed the Xia at Changbo River with two thousand heads taken and twice as many cattle and horses.

sentences.zh: 壬午，命官編類司馬光等改廢法度論奏事狀。

translations.literal: Day renchen: officials were ordered to compile memorials by Sima Guang and others debating laws changed and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, officials were ordered to compile Sima Guang’s memorials on laws changed and abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，令諸獄置氣樓涼窗，設漿飲薦席，杻械五日一浣，系囚以時沐浴，遇寒給薪炭。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dinghai: all prisons were to install vent towers and cool windows, provide drink and rush mats, wash shackles every five days, bathe prisoners on schedule, and give fuel in cold weather.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dinghai: prisons gained vent towers, cool windows, regular bathing, shackles washed every five days, and winter fuel.

sentences.zh: 甲午，熙河築金城關。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Xihe circuit built Jincheng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Xihe built Jincheng Pass.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔發解省試添策一道。

translations.literal: Day bingshen, edict: one policy question was added to the metropolitan and provincial examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, metropolitan and provincial exams gained an added policy question.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，進編臣僚章疏一百四十三帙。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: one hundred forty-three fascicles of compiled officials’ memorials were submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, 143 fascicles of compiled officials’ memorials were submitted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，呂大防卒於虔州。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Lü Dafang died at Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Lü Dafang died at Qianzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，知保安軍李沂伐夏國，破洪州。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: Li Yi, commander of Bao’an Army, attacked the Xia state and took Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Bao’an commander Li Yi attacked Xia and captured Hongzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，環慶鈐轄張存入鹽州，俘戮甚衆，及還，夏人追襲之，復多亡失。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Huanqing circuit controller Zhang Cun entered Yanzhou and captured or killed many; on the return march the Xia pursued and many were lost again.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Zhang Cun raided Yanzhou with heavy kills and captures, but Xia pursuit on the return cost many men.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，置克戎砦、平夏城，置靈平砦。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Kerong Stockade and Pingxia City were established, and Lingping Stockade was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Kerong Stockade, Pingxia City, and Lingping Stockade were established.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以西邊板築有勞，曲赦陝西、河東路。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: because of merit in frontier stockade building, a partial amnesty was granted in Shaanxi and Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Shaanxi and Hedong received a partial amnesty for frontier construction service.

sentences.zh: 追貶王珪爲萬安軍司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Wang Gui was posthumously demoted to registrar of Wan’an Army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui was posthumously demoted to Wan’an Army registrar.

sentences.zh: 己酉，復文德殿侍從轉對。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Wende Hall attendant rotation memorials were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wende Hall attendant rotation memorials were restored.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi new moon: Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renzi new moon: Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，封湖州觀察使世開爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiyou: Observation commissioner Shikai of Huzhou was enfeoffed Prince of Anding commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, yiyou: Huzhou observation commissioner Shikai became Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，鄜延將王湣復宥州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Fuyan general Wang Min recovered Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Fuyan general Wang Min recovered Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，封宗祐爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: Zongyou was enfeoffed as heir to the Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zongyou was made heir Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 築威戎城。

translations.literal: Weirong city was built.
translations.idiomatic: Weirong city was built.

sentences.zh: 己酉，彗出西方。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: a comet appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a comet appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，以星變，避殿減膳，罷秋宴，詔公卿悉心修政，以輔不逮，求中外直言。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renzi: because of the omen, the emperor left the hall and reduced his meals, the autumn banquet was canceled, and an edict ordered the grandees to devote themselves to government reform to aid his shortcomings and sought frank speech inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renzi: after the omen the emperor left court, cut his meals, canceled the autumn banquet, and called for reform and frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，赦天下，出元豐庫緡錢四百萬付陝西廣糴，詔歸明人未給田者舍以官舍。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the realm was pardoned; four million strings of cash from the Yuanfeng treasury were issued to Shaanxi for broad grain purchases; Ming returnees still without land grants were to lodge in official quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, a general amnesty released four million strings for Shaanxi grain buying and lodged landless Ming returnees in official housing.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，彗滅。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the comet vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the comet vanished.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，謁中太一宮爲民祈福。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the emperor visited the Central Supreme Unity Palace to pray for the people.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, he prayed for the people at the Central Supreme Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the emperor resumed meals in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, court meals in the main hall resumed.

sentences.zh: 命宗景爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Zongjing was appointed Honored Attendant of the Highest Office.
translations.idiomatic: Zongjing was made Honored Attendant of the Highest Office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，封婉儀劉氏爲賢妃。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Lady Wan, the Honored Lady Liu, was ennobled Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Lady Wan Liu became Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，宗景薨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: Zongjing died.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuxu: Zongjing died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，廢安國、安陽淇水監及洛陽原武監。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Anguo, Anyang Qishui, and Luoyang Yuanwu coin directorates were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Anguo, Anyang Qishui, and Luoyang Yuanwu coin offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，詔諫議大夫以上各舉監察御史一人。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingmao, edict: remonstrance officials of fifth rank and above were each to nominate one surveillance censor.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingmao: each remonstrance official of fifth rank or higher was to nominate one surveillance censor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，貶劉奉世爲隰州團練副使、郴州安置。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Liu Fengshi was demoted to regiment vice commander of Xizhou and exiled to Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Liu Fengshi was demoted to Xizhou regiment vice commander and exiled to Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔放歸田里程頤涪州編管。

translations.literal: Day dingchou, edict: Cheng Yi was released from Fuzhou detention to return to his fields.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Cheng Yi was released from Fuzhou detention to return home.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，劉摯卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiwei: Liu Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiwei: Liu Zhi died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，曲宴遼使於垂拱殿。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: an informal banquet for Liao envoys was held at Chuigong Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Liao envoys were entertained informally at Chuigong Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，侍御史董敦逸坐奏對不實，貶秩、知興國軍。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: attendant censor Dong Dunyi, convicted of false statements at audience, was demoted in rank and made prefect of Xingguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Dong Dunyi was demoted and sent to Xingguo Army for false statements at audience.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩浙旱饑，詔行荒政，移粟振貸。

translations.literal: That year the Two Zhe circuits suffered drought and famine; an edict ordered famine relief and grain was moved for relief loans.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought and famine struck the Two Zhe; relief grain was moved on loan.

sentences.zh: 出宮女二十四人。

translations.literal: Twenty-four palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 宣城民妻一產四男子。

translations.literal: A Xuancheng commoner’s wife bore four sons at one birth.
translations.idiomatic: A Xuancheng woman bore quadruplets.

sentences.zh: 于闐、西南蕃羅氏入貢。

translations.literal: Yutian and the southwestern Fan Luo clan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Yutian and the southwestern Luo tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 播州夷楊光榮等內附。

translations.literal: The Bozhou Yi Yang Guangrong and others submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guangrong of Bozhou and other Yi submitted.

sentences.zh: 戶部主戶一千三百六萬八千七百四十一，丁三千三十四萬四千二百七十四；

translations.literal: Registered households under the Ministry of Revenue numbered 13,068,741, with 30,344,274 adult males;
translations.idiomatic: Registered households totaled 13,068,741 with 30,344,274 adult males;

sentences.zh: 客戶六百三十六萬六千八百二十九，丁三百六萬七千三百三十二。

translations.literal: tenant households numbered 6,366,829, with 3,067,332 adult males.
translations.idiomatic: tenant households 6,366,829 with 3,067,332 adult males.

sentences.zh: 大辟三千一百九十二人。

translations.literal: Capital punishment cases numbered 3,192.
translations.idiomatic: Capital sentences numbered 3,192.

sentences.zh: 元符元年春正月庚戌朔，不視朝。

translations.literal: Year one of Yuanfu, spring, first month, day gengxu new moon: court audience was not held.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfu year one, first month, gengxu new moon: no court audience was held.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，咸陽民段義得玉印一紐。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the commoner Duan Yi of Xianyang obtained one jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Xianyang commoner Duan Yi found a jade seal.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸瑞聖園，觀北郊齋宮。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: the emperor visited Ruisheng Garden and inspected the North Suburban fast palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, he visited Ruisheng Garden and the North Suburban fast palace.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingxu: a white rainbow crossed the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔建五王外第。

translations.literal: Day gengyin, edict: outer mansions were to be built for the five princes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, outer mansions for the five princes were ordered built.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，復罷翰林侍讀、侍講學士。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Hanlin reader and lecturer posts were again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hanlin reader and lecturer posts were abolished again.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宗祐薨。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Zongyou died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zongyou died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，知蘭州王舜臣討夏人於塞外。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Wang Shunchen, prefect of Lanzhou, attacked the Xia beyond the border.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Lanzhou prefect Wang Shunchen attacked Xia beyond the border.

sentences.zh: 築興平城。

translations.literal: Xingping city was built.
translations.idiomatic: Xingping city was built.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，令三省、樞密吏三歲一試刑法。

translations.literal: Third month, day renzi: clerks of the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs were to be examined in criminal law every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renzi: Three Departments and Military Affairs clerks were to sit a triennial criminal-law exam.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，開楚州通漣河。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Chuzhou’s Tonglian River was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Chuzhou’s Tonglian River was opened.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，米脂砦成。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Mizhi Stockade was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Mizhi Stockade was completed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，五王外第成，賜名懿親宅。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the five princes’ outer mansions were completed and named the Worthy Kin Residence.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the five princes’ mansions were finished and named the Worthy Kin Residence.

sentences.zh: 戊午，封宗漢爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Zonghan was enfeoffed as heir to the Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zonghan was made heir Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 殺朱崖流人陳衍。

translations.literal: The exiled Chen Yan at Zhuya was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Exile Chen Yan was executed at Zhuya.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，申王佖、端王佶並爲司空。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Prince Shen Bian and Prince Duan Ji were both made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Princes Shen and Duan were both made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 令太常寺與閣門修定刈麥儀。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Gate office were ordered to revise the rites for the wheat harvest.
translations.idiomatic: The Sacrifices court and Gate office were ordered to revise wheat-harvest rites.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔翰林學士承旨蔡京等辯驗段義所獻玉璽，定議以聞。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: Hanlin academician recipient Cai Jing and others were to authenticate the jade seal presented by Duan Yi and report a settled opinion.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Cai Jing and others were ordered to authenticate Duan Yi’s jade seal and report.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，吏部郎中方澤等坐私謁後族宴聚，罰金補外。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Ministry of Personnel bureau director Fang Ze and others, convicted of privately visiting the empress’s kin at banquets, were fined and sent to posts outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Fang Ze and others were fined and posted outside the capital for privately feasting with the empress’s kin.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸申王府。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the emperor visited Prince Shen’s mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the emperor visited Prince Shen’s mansion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸端王府。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the emperor visited Prince Duan’s mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the emperor visited Prince Duan’s mansion.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，進封咸甯郡王俁爲莘王，普甯郡王似爲簡王，祁國公偲爲永甯郡王。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Prince of Xianning commandery Yi was advanced to Prince of Xin; Prince of Puning commandery Si was made Prince of Jian; Duke of Qi Si was made Prince of Yongning commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Prince Yi of Xianning became Prince of Xin; Prince Si of Puning became Prince of Jian; Duke Si of Qi became Prince of Yongning.

sentences.zh: 丙子，築熙河通會關。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Xihe built Tonghui Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Xihe built Tonghui Pass.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，世開薨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: Shikai died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen: Shikai died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幸睿成宮及莘王、簡王府。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the emperor visited Ruicheng Palace and the mansions of the Princes of Xin and Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, he visited Ruicheng Palace and the Xin and Jian princes’ mansions.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，章惇等進《神宗帝紀》。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Zhang Dun and others submitted the Imperial Annals of Emperor Shenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Zhang Dun and others presented the Imperial Annals of Emperor Shenzong.

sentences.zh: 梁燾卒於化州。

translations.literal: Liang Dhao died at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Dhao died at Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，林希罷。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Lin Xi left office.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Lin Xi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，建顯謨閣，藏《神宗御集》。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the Manifest Exposition Pavilion was built to house the Imperial Collection of Emperor Shenzong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Manifest Exposition Pavilion was built for Shenzong’s Imperial Collection.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸睿成宮。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: the emperor visited Ruicheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the emperor visited Ruicheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，學士院上《寶璽》、《靈光》、《翔鶴》樂章。

translations.literal: Day renyin: the Academy of Scholarly Worthies submitted the anthem chapters “Precious Seal,” “Numinous Radiance,” and “Soaring Cranes.”
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the Academy submitted the anthems “Precious Seal,” “Numinous Radiance,” and “Soaring Cranes.”

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔學官增習兩經。

translations.literal: Day guimao, edict: school officers were to add study of the two classics.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, school officers were ordered to add study of the two classics.

sentences.zh: 丁未，曾布上《刪修軍馬敕例》。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Zeng Bu submitted the Revised Military Horse Edicts and Precedents.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Zeng Bu submitted the Revised Military Horse Edicts and Precedents.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申朔，御大慶殿，受天授傳國受命寶，行朝會禮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wushen new moon: at Daqing Hall the emperor received the Heaven-Bestowed Transmitting-the-Realm Receiving-the-Mandate Treasure and performed court audience rites.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wushen new moon: at Daqing Hall he received the mandate jade treasure and held court rites.

sentences.zh: 己酉，班德音於天下，減囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: a benevolent edict was proclaimed throughout the realm; prisoners’ sentences were reduced one degree and those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, a benevolent edict cut sentences one grade and freed those below penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，受寶，恭謝景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the treasure was received and thanksgiving was offered at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the treasure was received and thanksgiving offered at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宴紫宸殿。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: a banquet was held at Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, a banquet was held at Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔獻寶人段義爲右班殿直，賜絹二百匹。

translations.literal: Day gengshen, edict: Duan Yi, who presented the treasure, was made a guard officer of the right file and granted two hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, seal-presenter Duan Yi became a right-file guard officer with two hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅朔，改元。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuyin new moon: the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuyin new moon: the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣官分詣鄜延、涇原、河東、熙河按驗所築城砦。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: officials were dispatched separately to Fuyan, Jingyuan, Hedong, and Xihe to inspect stockades and cities that had been built.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, officials were sent to Fuyan, Jingyuan, Hedong, and Xihe to inspect frontier works.

sentences.zh: 甲午，蔡京等上《常平免役敕令》。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Cai Jing and others submitted the Ever-Normal Granary and Exemption Service edicts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Cai Jing and others submitted the Ever-Normal and Exemption Service edicts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，詔增置大府丞一員。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yimao, edict: one additional vice director of the Grand Storehouse was added.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yimao: one Grand Storehouse vice director was added.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，敕大禮五使自今並差執政官，定爲令。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: hereafter the five commissioners of great rites were all to be executive officials, fixed as statute.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the five great-rites commissioners were fixed as executive officials by statute.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，令學官試《三經》。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: school officers were to examine the Three Classics.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, school officers were to examine the Three Classics.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔范祖禹移化州安置，劉安世梅州安置，王岩叟、朱光庭諸子並勒停不敘。

translations.literal: Day gengwu, edict: Fan Zuyu was moved to exile at Huazhou; Liu Anshi to Meizhou; the sons of Wang Yansou and Zhu Guangting were all stripped of office without reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Fan Zuyu was exiled to Huazhou, Liu Anshi to Meizhou, and the sons of Wang Yansou and Zhu Guangting were stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 壬申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day renshen: the capital region was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the capital was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子朔，熙河蘭岷路復爲熙河蘭會路。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingzi new moon: the Xihe–Lan–Min circuit was restored as the Xihe–Lan–Hui circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, bingzi new moon: Xihe–Lan–Min circuit was restored as Xihe–Lan–Hui.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔自今三省、樞密院進擬在京文臣、開封推判官、武臣橫班使副及諸路監司、帥守，並取旨召對。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, edict: henceforth nominations by the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs for capital civil officials, Kaifeng judicial reviewers, frontier military commissioners and deputies, and circuit intendants and commanders were all to await imperial audience and decree.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Three Departments and Military Affairs nominations for capital and frontier posts required imperial audience.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔侍從中書舍人以上各舉所知二人，權侍郎以上舉一人，仍指言所堪職任。

translations.literal: Day dinghai, edict: attendants from Secretariat drafter upward were each to recommend two men they knew; acting vice ministers and above one man, stating the offices each could fill.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, attendants and acting vice ministers were ordered to recommend talent with stated suitable posts.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，以霖雨，罷秋宴。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei: because of heavy rain, the autumn banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingwei: heavy rain canceled the autumn banquet.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，秦觀除名，移雷州編管。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Qin Guan was struck from the rolls and exiled to Leizhou under detention.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Qin Guan was disgraced and exiled to Leizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜王安石第于京師。

translations.literal: Day guihai: a residence in the capital was granted to Wang Anshi.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Wang Anshi was granted a capital residence.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，詔武官試換文資。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yimao, edict: military officers were to be examined to exchange into civil qualification.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yimao: military officers were examined for transfer into the civil track.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以河北、京東河溢，遣官振恤。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: because the Yellow River overflowed in Hebei and Jingdong, officials were dispatched for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, officials were sent to relieve Hebei and Jingdong after Yellow River floods.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，夏人寇平夏城。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Xia raided Pingxia city.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Xia raided Pingxia city.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，附馬都尉張敦禮坐元祐初上疏譽司馬光，奪留後，授環衛官。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Zhang Dunli, for memorializing in praise of Sima Guang at the start of Yuanyou, was stripped of military deputy commissioner rank and given a post in the Palace Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Zhang Dunli lost his deputy commissioner rank and was posted to the Palace Guards for praising Sima Guang early in Yuanyou.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renxu: audience offering at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renxu: offerings were made at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: Day guihai: court feast at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the court feasted at the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲子，祀昊天上帝於圜丘，赦天下。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: August Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound; an empire-wide amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Circular Mound and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 是歲，澶州河溢，振恤河北、京東被水者。

translations.literal: That year the Yellow River overflowed at Dazhou; relief was given to flood victims in Hebei and Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Yellow River burst at Dazhou and Hebei and Jingdong flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 真定府、祁州野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: In Zhending prefecture and Qizhou, wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: Wild silkworms spun cocoons in Zhending and Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 涇原路禽夏國統軍嵬名阿埋等，高麗、瞎征、西南蕃張氏、羅氏、程氏入貢。

translations.literal: The Jingyuan circuit captured Xia commander-in-chief Weiming Ami and others; Goryeo, Xiazheng, and the southwestern Fan Zhang, Luo, and Cheng clans came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan took Xia commander Weiming Ami and others; Goryeo, Xiazheng, and southwestern Zhang, Luo, and Cheng tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 西蕃首領李訛𠼪、巴詘支、呂承信等內附。

translations.literal: Western Fan leaders Li E, Ba Quzhi, Lü Chengxin, and others submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Western Fan leaders Li E, Ba Quzhi, Lü Chengxin, and others came in.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲辰朔，御大慶殿，以雪罷朝，群臣及遼使詣東上閣門拜表賀。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jiachen new moon: at Great Celebration Hall, audience was canceled for snow; ministers and Liao envoys went to the Eastern Upper Gate to submit congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Fu 2, spring, jiachen new moon: snow canceled court at Great Celebration Hall; officials and Liao envoys congratulated by memorial at the Eastern Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 群臣又詣內東門，賀如儀。

translations.literal: The ministers again went to the Inner Eastern Gate and congratulated according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: They congratulated again at the Inner Eastern Gate by ritual.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，出內金帛二百萬，備陝西邊儲。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: two million in gold and silks from the inner treasury was issued to stock the Shaanxi frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, two million in inner treasury gold and silk went to stock the Shaanxi frontier.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌朔，令監司舉本路學行優異者各二人。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu new moon: surveillance commissioners were ordered to recommend two men each in their circuits of outstanding learning and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiaxu new moon: each circuit supervisor was to recommend two men of outstanding learning and conduct.

sentences.zh: 韋蕃入貢。

translations.literal: Wei Fan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Fan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔許高麗國王遣士賓貢。

translations.literal: Day jimao, edict: the king of Goryeo was permitted to send scholars as tribute candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Goryeo king was allowed to send scholar-tribute candidates.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，增置神臂弓，詔自今應被旨舉官，所舉不當，具舉主姓名以聞。
