translations.literal: Day xinsi: Divine Arm bows were added; an edict ordered that when officials nominated by imperial order proved unfit, the nominator’s name was to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Divine Arm bows were added; unfit nominees of imperial appointment required the nominator’s name reported.

sentences.zh: 甲申，夏人以國母卒，遣使告哀，且謝罪，卻其使不納。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: because the Xia empress dowager had died, they sent envoys to announce mourning and also apologize; the envoys were turned back and not received.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Xia mourning and apology envoys for the empress dowager’s death were refused.

sentences.zh: 戊子，鄜延鈐轄劉安敗夏人於神堆。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: Fuyan frontier commander Liu An defeated the Xia at Shendui.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Liu An of Fuyan beat the Xia at Shendui.

sentences.zh: 甲午，大食入貢。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Dashi presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Dashi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔吏部：守令課績，從御史台考察，黜其不實者。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict to the Ministry of Personnel: magistrates’ performance ratings were to be examined by the Censorate, and false entries were to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Personnel was told to have the Censorate test magistrates’ ratings and strike false ones.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，遼人遣簽書樞密院事蕭德崇來爲夏人請緩師，仍獻玉帶。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: Liao sent Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Xiao Dechong to ask a respite for the Xia and also presented a jade belt.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingchen: Xiao Dechong of Liao asked a truce for Xia and presented a jade belt.

sentences.zh: 築環慶路定邊城。

translations.literal: Dingbian city in the Huanqing circuit was built.
translations.idiomatic: Dingbian city was built in Huanqing circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，秦鳳經略司言吳名革率部族、孳畜歸順。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the Qin Feng pacification office reported that Wu Mingge led his tribes and livestock to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Qin Feng reported Wu Mingge’s tribes and herds submitting.

sentences.zh: 詔名革補內殿承制，首領李𠼪補右侍禁，及賜錢帛有差。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Wu Mingge Inner Hall Gentlemen-Attendant; the leader Li E was made Right Palace Guard; cash and silks were granted in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mingge was made Inner Hall Gentlemen-Attendant, Li E Right Palace Guard, and graded cash and silk were granted.

sentences.zh: 庚申，知府州折克行獲夏國鈐轄令王皆保。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: Zhe Kexing, prefect of Fuzhou, captured Xia frontier commander Ling Wangjiebao.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Fuzhou prefect Zhe Kexing took Xia commander Ling Wangjiebao.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，祈雨。

translations.literal: Day yichou: rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, prayers were offered for rain.

sentences.zh: 己巳，莘王俁爲司空。

translations.literal: Day jisi: Prince of Xin You was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Prince of Xin You was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，幸莘王府。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengchen: the emperor visited the Prince of Xin’s mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengchen: the emperor visited Prince Xin’s mansion.

sentences.zh: 令廣西提點刑獄司兼領鹽事。

translations.literal: The Guangxi judicial intendant was ordered also to oversee salt affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi’s judicial intendant was also put in charge of salt.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，築鄜延、河東路暖泉、烏龍砦。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Nuannquan and Wulong stockades were built on the Fuyan and Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Nuannquan and Wulong stockades were built in Fuyan and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以旱，減四京囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: because of drought, crimes in the Four Capitals were reduced one grade; those at bamboo punishment and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, drought brought one-grade sentence relief in the Four Capitals and release for bamboo punishments and below.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔鞫獄，徒以上須結案及錄審覆奏，然後斷遣，不如令者坐之。

translations.literal: Day xinmao, edict on trials: for exile and above, cases had to be closed and the review memorial submitted before sentence was carried out; violators were punished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, exile-and-above sentences required closed cases and review memorials before execution; violators were punished.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，封永嘉郡王偲爲睦王。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Prince of Yongjia commandery Si was enfeoffed as Prince Mu.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Prince Si of Yongjia was enfeoffed Prince Mu.

sentences.zh: 遣中書舍人郭知章報聘於遼。

translations.literal: Palace Drafting Academician Guo Zhizhang was sent on a return mission to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhizhang was sent on a return embassy to Liao.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，築威羌城。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Weiyang city was built.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Weiyang city was built.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiachen: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiachen: Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，築鄜延路金湯城。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Jintang city was built on the Fuyan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Jintang city was built on the Fuyan circuit.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，奉遷真宗神御于萬壽觀延聖殿。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Emperor Zhenzong’s spirit likeness was reverently moved to Yansheng Hall of Wanshou Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhenzong’s spirit portrait was moved to Yansheng Hall at Wanshou Temple.

sentences.zh: 曲赦陝西、河東路，減囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for the Shaanxi and Hedong circuits; crimes were reduced one grade and those at exile and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi and Hedong won a partial amnesty, one-grade relief, and release for exile and below.

sentences.zh: 建西安州及天都等砦。

translations.literal: Xi’an prefecture and stockades such as Tiandu were established.
translations.idiomatic: Xi’an prefecture and Tiandu and other stockades were built.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，進章惇官五等，曾布三等，許將、蔡卞、黃履皆二等。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhang Dun was advanced five grades in rank, Zeng Bu three, and Xu Jiang, Cai Bian, and Huang Lü two each.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Dun rose five grades, Zeng Bu three, and Xu Jiang, Cai Bian, and Huang Lü two each.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔莘王俁、睦王偲母進封婕妤。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, edict: the mothers of Prince of Xin You and Prince Mu Si were advanced to Jieyu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the mothers of Princes Xin and Mu were advanced to Jieyu.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，賜蘭、會州新砦名會川城。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: the new stockade in Lan and Hui prefectures was named Huichuan city.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, gengchen: the new Lan–Hui stockade was named Huichuan city.

sentences.zh: 甲午，賜環慶路之字平曰清平關。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Huanqing circuit pass marked only with the character zhi was named Qingping Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Huanqing’s unnamed “zhi” pass was named Qingping Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，築定邊、白豹城訖工，閣門使張存等轉官、賜金帛有差。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: construction of Dingbian and Baibao cities was completed; Gate Commissioner Zhang Cun and others were transferred in rank and granted gold and silks in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Dingbian and Baibao were finished; Zhang Cun and others were promoted and rewarded in graded gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，盛暑，中外決系囚。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yisi: in great heat, prisoners were reviewed inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yisi: in midsummer heat, prisoners were reviewed throughout the government.

sentences.zh: 丁未，放在京工役。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: corvée laborers in the capital were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, capital corvée laborers were released.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，河北河漲，沒民田廬，遣官振之。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: the Yellow River rose in Hebei and drowned people’s fields and houses; officials were dispatched for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Hebei’s Yellow River drowned fields and homes and relief officials were sent.

sentences.zh: 甲子，知環州種朴獲夏國監軍訛勃囉。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Zhong Pu, prefect of Huanzhou, captured Xia military supervisor Eboluo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Huanzhou prefect Zhong Pu took Xia supervisor Eboluo.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，洮西安撫使王贍復邈川城，西蕃首領欽彪阿成以城降。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Tao River pacification commissioner Wang Zhan recovered Miaochuan city; the Western Fan leader Qinbiao Acheng surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wang Zhan of Tao River recovered Miaochuan; Western Fan leader Qinbiao Acheng surrendered it.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉，章惇等進《新修敕令式》。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiyou: Zhang Dun and others submitted the Newly Revised Statutes and Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guiyou: Zhang Dun and others presented the Newly Revised Statutes and Regulations.

sentences.zh: 惇讀於帝前，其間有元豐所無而用元祐敕令修立者，帝曰：「元祐亦有可取乎？

translations.literal: Dun read before the throne; where Yuanfeng lacked provisions and Yuanyou statutes had been used in revision, the emperor said: “Did Yuanyou too have points worth taking?”
translations.idiomatic: Dun read before the throne; where Yuanfeng lacked rules filled from Yuanyou statutes, the emperor asked: “Was Yuanyou worth taking from?”

sentences.zh: 」惇等對曰：「取其善者。

translations.literal: Dun and the others replied: “We took what was good.”
translations.idiomatic: Dun and the others answered: “We took what was good.”

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，太原地震。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Taiyuan was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Taiyuan was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇子生。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: a prince was born.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, a prince was born.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，降德音于諸路：減囚罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: a benevolent amnesty edict was proclaimed on all circuits: crimes were reduced one grade and those at exile and below were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, a benevolent amnesty on all circuits cut sentences one grade and freed exile and below.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜熙河路緡錢百萬撫納部族。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: one million strings in cash on the Xihe circuit was granted to pacify and win over the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xihe received one million strings to pacify the tribes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，復修會州。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Huizhou was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Huizhou was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Venus appeared in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 瞎征降。

translations.literal: Xiazheng submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Xiazheng submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，建葭蘆戍爲晉寧軍。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Jialu garrison was made Jining army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Jialu garrison was made Jining army.

sentences.zh: 丙申，保寧軍節度呂惠卿特授檢校司空。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Baoning army military commissioner Lü Huiqing was specially appointed Honorary Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Lü Huiqing of Baoning army was specially made Honorary Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬子，詔河北大名二十二州軍置馬步軍指揮，以廣威、保捷爲名。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renzi, edict: in the twenty-two prefectures and armies of Daming in Hebei, horse and foot army commands were established, named Broad Might and Secure Valor.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, renzi: Hebei’s twenty-two Daming prefectures and armies gained horse-and-foot commands named Broad Might and Secure Valor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，日有食之，既。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: there was an eclipse of the sun; it was total.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the sun was totally eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，詔綏德城爲綏德軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dinghai, edict: Suide city was made Suide army.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dinghai: Suide city was made Suide army.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔河北黃河退灘地聽民耕墾，免租稅三年。

translations.literal: Day renchen, edict: on Yellow River retreat lands in Hebei the people were permitted to reclaim and farm, with taxes remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Hebei Yellow River retreat lands could be farmed tax-free for three years.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔諸州置教授者，依太學三舍法考選生徒升補。

translations.literal: Day yiwei, edict: in prefectures that had professors, students were to be examined and advanced by the Imperial University’s three-hall method.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, prefectures with professors were to examine students by the university’s three-hall method.

sentences.zh: 是月，河中猗氏縣民妻一產四男子。

translations.literal: That month a wife in Yishi county, Hezhong, gave birth to four sons at one delivery.
translations.idiomatic: That month a Hezhong Yishi wife bore quadruplets—all sons.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛未，帝有疾，不視朝。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day xinwei: the emperor was ill and did not hold audience.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Fu 3, spring, xinwei: the emperor was ill and held no audience.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，奉安太宗皇帝御容于景靈宮大定殿。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Emperor Taizong’s imperial portrait was installed at Dading Hall of Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Taizong’s portrait was installed at Dading Hall in Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大赦天下，蠲民租。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: a great amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven and the people’s rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the realm was greatly amnestied and rents remitted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，帝崩。

translations.literal: Day jimao: the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 皇太后諭遺制，立弟端王即位於柩前，皇太后權同處分軍國事。

translations.literal: The empress dowager announced the testamentary disposition: the younger brother Prince Duan was enthroned before the coffin; the empress dowager was to exercise joint disposal of state and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager announced the will: Prince Duan was enthroned before the coffin and she jointly disposed of state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 四月己未，上諡曰欽文睿武昭孝皇帝，廟號曰哲宗。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiwei: the posthumous title was set as Emperor of Respectful Culture, Sagely Martial, and Proclaiming Filiality; the temple name was Zhezong.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, jiwei: he was posthumously titled Respectful Culture, Sagely Martial, Proclaiming Filial and temple-named Zhezong.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，以諡號冊寶奏告天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day dingmao: the posthumous title and book of investiture were presented to Heaven, Earth, the Ancestral Temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingmao: the posthumous title and investiture book were proclaimed to heaven, earth, temple, and altars.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，葬於永泰陵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renyin: he was buried at Yongtai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, renyin: burial at Yongtai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，祔太廟。

translations.literal: Day guihai: he was enshrined in the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, he entered the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 崇寧三年七月，加諡曰憲元繼道世德揚功欽文睿武齊聖昭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Chongning, third year, seventh month: the posthumous title was augmented as Emperor of Constitutional Origin, Continuing the Way, Worldly Virtue, and Raising Merit, Respectful Culture, Sagely Martial, Equal Sage, and Proclaiming Filiality.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning 3, seventh month: his posthumous title was lengthened with Constitutional Origin, Continuing the Way, Worldly Virtue, Raising Merit, Equal Sage, and Proclaiming Filiality.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，改諡憲元繼道顯德定功欽文睿武齊聖昭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Zhenghe, third year: the posthumous title was changed to Emperor of Constitutional Origin, Continuing the Way, Manifest Virtue, and Settling Merit, Respectful Culture, Sagely Martial, Equal Sage, and Proclaiming Filiality.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenghe 3: his posthumous title was revised to Constitutional Origin, Continuing the Way, Manifest Virtue, Settling Merit, Equal Sage, and Proclaiming Filiality.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：折宗以沖幼踐阼，宣仁同政。

translations.literal: Appraisal: Zhezong took the throne in extreme youth and Xuanren shared government.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: Zhezong came to the throne very young and Xuanren ruled with him.

sentences.zh: 初年召用馬、呂諸賢，罷青苗，復常平，登俊良，辟言路，天下人心，翕然向治。

translations.literal: Early on he recalled worthies of the Ma and Lü factions, abolished Green Sprouts, restored Ever-Normal Granaries, elevated the able, and opened remonstrance roads—and the realm’s hearts turned as one toward good order.
translations.idiomatic: At first he recalled Ma and Lü worthies, ended Green Sprouts, restored Ever-Normal Granaries, raised the able, and opened remonstrance—and hearts everywhere turned toward order.

sentences.zh: 而元祐之政，庶幾仁宗。

translations.literal: The Yuanyou governance nearly matched Renzong’s.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyou rule nearly matched Renzong’s.

sentences.zh: 奈何熙、豐舊奸枿去未盡，已而媒蘖復用，卒假紹述之言，務反前政，報復善良，馴致黨籍禍興，君子盡斥，而宋政益敝矣。

translations.literal: Yet Xining and Yuanfeng old villains were not fully uprooted; soon agents slandered and they were restored; at last, under the banner of “continuing the legacy,” they bent every effort to reverse the prior policies, repaying kindness with injury, until party-register calamities rose, gentlemen were wholly expelled, and Song governance grew ever more debilitated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Xining–Yuanfeng villains were not uprooted; slander soon restored them; under “continuing the legacy” they reversed prior policy, punished the good, filled the party registers, expelled gentlemen, and Song rule grew weaker.

sentences.zh: 籲，可惜哉！

translations.literal: Alas—what a pity!
translations.idiomatic: Alas—what a pity!
